$comment: Single declaration of the ensemble hook set. Every hook file that exists on disk has exactly one entry here, including files that are deliberately not event-registered (registration: 'model-invoked' or 'none'). Three consumers are generated FROM this manifest (see docs/TRD/runtime-refresh.md §2.3 / §4.2, tasks RUNTIME-B001/B002/B003 — not implemented by this file itself): (a) the scaffold-project.sh copy list, (b) the template settings.json hook block (event order preserved via 'order'), (c) the hook enumeration table in init-project.md. Do not hand-edit the generated artifacts once B001-B003 land; edit this manifest instead. 'source' is present only when the hook file lives outside packages/core/hooks/ (cross-package hooks); its absence means the file lives at packages/core/hooks/<file>. 'shippable' marks hooks that should be symlinked into packages/full/hooks/ and copied by scaffold-project.sh into a target project's .claude/hooks/. permitter, learning.sh, and save-remote-logs.js were retired and deleted in 4.1.0 and intentionally have NO entry — do not re-add them from the stale docs/TRD/runtime-refresh.md §2.3 example, which predates the removal.

hooks.description: Static framework-leverage reminder injected on every user prompt.
Auto-formats files touched by Edit/Write/MultiEdit using project-detected formatters.
Active state machine: advances cycle_position in `implement.json` as subagents complete.

Blocks a subagent's fire-and-forget / deferred-work claims (ScheduleWakeup is unavailable to subagents, so such claims are false by construction); capped consecutive blocks per agent_id as a loop guard (pairs with `.claude/rules/async-discipline.md`).
Blocks fire-and-forget async claims made without real async machinery in flight (pairs with `.claude/rules/async-discipline.md`).
Blocks hedged mid-loop pause offers that violate autonomous-execution discipline (pairs with `.claude/rules/autonomy.md`).
Autonomous loop intercept/continuation, capped at 50 iterations.
Optional outbound notification (`NOTIFY_ON_STOP`) fired every time a session stops.
Auto-loads in-flight TRD/PRD state from `.trd-state/current.json` into session context.
Refreshes vendored `.claude/` components already present from a newer installed plugin (present-only, monotonic version gate); see `docs/TRD/runtime-refresh.md`.
Archives a decision-trail checkpoint to `.trd-state/<feature>/session-log.md` before context compaction.
Invoked directly by commands (not by an event) on their COMMAND COMPLETE turn to fire `NOTIFY_ON_COMPLETE` exactly once; see `.claude/rules/command-status.md` Path B.
